g.text: Nominal 25 °C / 1C | All 15 source pairs | Time-weighted RMSE [mV]

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #41515e

g.text: Symmetric display: each pair is repeated. Diagonal: not applicable.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #344550

g.text: Each pair uses its own common observed time window; overlap intervals differ and are recorded in report.json.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #344550

g.text: Original commanded step-times; exact squared-difference integration. No extrapolation, offset, smoothing or normalization.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #344550

g.text: Voltage similarity does not establish shared histories, manufacturing batch, thermal behavior or a physical cause.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #344550

g.text: k2–k6 histories and measurement uncertainty remain unresolved. Measured skin-temperature spread is shown in the companion overlay.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #344550

g.text: These are measured-source differences, not model errors or independent validation.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
